responsibilities: Perform daily, weekly, and monthly NAV
Compare NAV calculated by fund administrators with internal records and resolve variances.
Perform daily cash & position reconciliation between Asset Managers/Funds and Custodians/Prime Brokers & investigate breaks and discrepancies in pricing and accruals as well.
Daily monitoring and review of activities like trades, capital stock, income, expense, various derivative products, corporate actions & pre/post pricing activities

Support process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency.

experience.company: Bank of New York, Pune, India

Maintaining the daily activity and perform the documentation part on daily basis. Conducting training session on fund and trade, money market and derivatives to the new joiner also to the onshore team & participating in BCP activity.
Resolving the issue while trade processing and increase the productivity.
Maintaining & updating SOP’s required for daily business activity Worked with SWIFT settlement instructions to support timely and accurate trade settlements across global markets.
